description: This file defines the TerminationReasonConfigurationService class, which provides methods to manage termination reasons within the OrangeHRM HRM system. It handles CRUD operations, searches, and checks related to termination reasons, acting as a service layer that interacts with the TerminationReasonConfigurationDao for data persistence.

classes.name: TerminationReasonConfigurationService
classes.description: Provides service methods to manage termination reasons, including CRUD operations, searching, counting, and validation, by interfacing with the data access object (DAO).

methods.name: getTerminationReasonDao
methods.description: Retrieves the dao instance; initializes it if not already set.

methods.name: setTerminationReasonDao
methods.description: Sets the dao instance, allowing dependency injection.

methods.name: saveTerminationReason
methods.description: Saves a TerminationReason entity to the database.

methods.name: getTerminationReasonById
methods.description: Fetches a termination reason by its unique identifier.

methods.name: getTerminationReasonByName
methods.description: Fetches a termination reason by its name.

methods.name: getTerminationReasonList
methods.description: Retrieves a list of termination reasons based on search filter parameters.

methods.name: getTerminationReasonCount
methods.description: Counts the number of termination reasons matching search filter parameters.

methods.name: deleteTerminationReasons
methods.description: Deletes multiple termination reasons given their IDs.

methods.name: isExistingTerminationReasonName
methods.description: Checks if a termination reason with the given name exists.

methods.name: getReasonIdsInUse
methods.description: Retrieves IDs of termination reasons currently in use.
